title: Senior Associate - Technology Risk Data Analyst
description: Senior Associate - Technology Risk Data Analyst Req ID: 128067 Department: Chief Information Risk Office Division: Risk Location: Bengaluru About Us Standard At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our millions of customers. About the Role As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Intelligence in our Risk, Group Technology team, you’ll play a key role supporting the Technology Risk Intelligence practice to deliver trusted, repeatable and decision-useful risk insights and AI-powered agents to strengthen the Risk, Group Technology team’s ability to provide clear, data-led risk insight and challenge so the Board, Executive Committee and regulators understand material risk positions against risk appetite, policy, regulatory expectations and critical service requirements. You will operate as a hands-on Associate, partnering with Senior Managers, Risk Managers and fellow Associates to deliver monitoring and analytics across material Technology and Information Security (Cyber) risk themes, support thematic reviews, events/issue analysis and governance, by collating evidence, analyzing indicators and synthesizing key risk theme insights. This will help to connect risk control and change signals to business impacts, service resilience, value chains and customer outcomes to improve oversight, challenge, risk measurement and quantification, prioritisation and risk decisions. Using approved automation and AI-enabled tooling (where authorised), you will develop and enhance automated insight products (dashboards, repeatable insight analysis, trend synthesis and first-draft packs), while maintaining strong data governance, privacy/security controls, and clear human accountability. Partnering with Risk specialists across the team, you will play a key support role in the evolution of technology and cyber risk appetite, metrics and oversight priorities via constructive challenge, executive-ready risk opinions and escalation of material concerns. This role may also provide support for International jurisdictions, partnering (as directed) with country risk officers to provide Line 2 technology and information security support as part of a matrixed Line 2 oversight model. Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours. Role Type: Permanent Role Location: Bengaluru Work Hours: 7 AM to 4 PM What will your day look like? As a Senior Associate, Technology Risk Intelligence, you are accountable for: Supporting the Senior Manager, Technology Risk Insights to deliver the insights plan by contributing to prioritised insight use-cases aligned to risk appetite, Board/ExCo metrics and material risk themes Building and maintaining insight assets (datasets, definitions, lineage notes, dashboards and briefing packs) that provide timely, trusted insight on control effectiveness, resilience outcomes, risk-in-change and remediation progress Supporting and delivering repeatable insight routines (e.g., indicator analysis, trend synthesis, evidence collation and first-draft packs) using approved automation and AI-enabled tooling (where authorized), with appropriate controls, QA and clear human accountability Maintaining audit-ready artefacts and evidence packs (definitions, assumptions, lineage and supporting evidence) to support Line 2 oversight, Internal Audit and regulatory engagement as required Providing hands-on Line 2 risk capacity to support independent oversight, review and challenge activities across Technology domains and cross-cutting disciplines (e.g., preparing analysis, summarizing evidence, drafting risk commentary and supporting thematic reviews) Partnering with Technology Risk leaders and senior Technology stakeholders to strengthen risk measurement and governance narrative by supporting indicator design, thresholds, trend interpretation and implications Producing executive-ready insight packs and dashboard views that link metrics to material risk themes, decisions required and recommended actions, with review by Managers/Senior Managers as appropriate Supporting governance forums by providing analysis, drafting insight commentary and evidence summaries; assisting with review of papers to ensure decision-readiness and consistent messaging Providing insight-led contributions to thematic reviews, events/issues analysis and emerging risk horizon scanning, synthesizing themes and root causes Supporting PACT-aligned NFR uplift through monitoring and analytics that inform Line 2 oversight priorities and escalation Operating as a developing specialist within the team, role-modelling analytical discipline, documentation and responsible tool use What will you bring? To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following: Minimim of 7+ years of experience in technology/cyber risk, operational risk, assurance or risk analytics within a complex regulated environment Strong analytical and data skills: shaping datasets, defining metrics/KRIs, and translating analysis into clear risk insights, trends and recommended actions Experience building and maintaining repeatable insight products (dashboards, packs, automated reporting) with strong data quality, definitions and lineage Practical understanding of technology and cyber controls and resilience concepts to enable credible challenge and interpretation of indicators Experience implementing automation and AI-enabled workflows (e.g., Copilot/LLM agents) with appropriate governance, controls and human accountability Strong written communication skills to produce concise, governance-ready insight packs and support senior stakeholders with clear messaging Ability to operate in a matrixed model with prioritisation, delivery discipline, and partnering capability across geographies Demonstrated ability to operate across regions (time zones and cultures), tailoring insights for local governance while maintaining consistent Group standards and comparability Good to have skills and experience Working knowledge of APRA standards relevant to technology and cyber (e.g., CPS 230, CPS 234) and evidence expectations Data science or engineering experience (e.g., statistical methods, NLP, MLOps) in a governed enterprise setting Exposure to international regulatory expectations for operational resilience/cyber and the ability to contribute to comparable risk insights and metrics (where applicable) You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you. Job Posting End Date 20/11/2026, 11.59pm
